rules.title: Flow uses a connection reference that is not defined
rules.fix: Add the connection reference to the solution, or add the solution that owns it as a dependency.

rules.title: Required environment variable has no default or current value
rules.fix: Give the variable a default value, or supply the value at deployment time and keep it out of the solution.

rules.title: Missing dependency has no owning solution
rules.fix: Add the missing component to the solution, or import the solution that provides it first.

rules.title: Flow calls a child flow that is not defined
rules.fix: Add the child flow to the solution, or add the solution that contains it as a dependency.

rules.title: Connection reference is not used by any flow or app
rules.fix: Remove the connection reference from the solution, or use it in the flow or app that needs it.

rules.title: Flow contains a hard-coded environment or SharePoint site URL
rules.fix: Remove the URL where the platform can use the current environment, otherwise read it from an environment variable whose value is set per environment at deployment.

rules.title: Environment variable default value looks environment-specific
rules.fix: Leave the default empty and set the value per environment at deployment time, or use a default that is valid everywhere.

rules.title: Environment variable ships a current value
rules.fix: Remove the current value before export, and supply per-environment values with deployment settings.

rules.title: Component name does not use the publisher prefix
rules.fix: Recreate the component under the solution's publisher, or keep it in a solution of the publisher that owns it and add that solution as a dependency.

rules.title: Solution uses a default or generated publisher prefix
rules.fix: Create a publisher with a meaningful prefix and build the solution under it.

rules.title: Cloud flow is turned off
rules.fix: Turn the flow on before export, or remove it from the solution if it is no longer needed.

rules.title: Dataverse row-updated trigger has no filter columns
rules.fix: Set the trigger's filter columns to the columns whose update should start the flow.

rules.title: Root component has no source folder in the YAML layout
rules.fix: Commit the component's folder and list it in solutioncomponents.yml, or remove the component from rootcomponents.yml.

rules.title: Canvas app formula contains a hard-coded environment or SharePoint site URL
rules.fix: Remove the URL where the platform can use the current environment, otherwise read it from an environment variable whose value is set per environment at deployment.

rules.title: Dataverse row-created trigger has filter columns
rules.fix: Clear the trigger's filter columns, or change its change type to Create or Update.

rules.title: Cloud flow has more than 50 actions or more than 4 levels of nesting
rules.fix: Move self-contained parts of the flow into child flows, and reduce nested scopes, conditions and loops.

rules.title: Cloud flow runs a loop inside a loop
rules.fix: Replace the inner loop with one query, filter or bulk action over the whole set, or fetch the related rows with the outer query's expand option and use one loop.

rules.title: Canvas app formula calls Patch or ForAll inside ForAll
rules.fix: Pass the ForAll result to one Patch call instead of calling Patch inside ForAll, and avoid nesting ForAll.

rules.title: Power Pages Web API fields setting is *
rules.fix: Replace * with the comma-separated logical names of the columns the site needs, or set UseFieldsFromView to True with a view that holds them.

rules.title: Power Pages Web API is enabled for a table with no fields setting
rules.fix: Add a fields site setting for the table with the columns the site needs, or set its UseFieldsFromView site setting to True with a view that holds them.

rules.title: Power Pages table permission has no web role
rules.fix: Associate the table permission with the web roles that need it, or delete it.

rules.title: Power Pages child table permission is not in effect through its parent
rules.fix: Give the parent table permission the child's web roles or remove them from the child, and keep the parent active.

rules.title: Power Pages table permission lets anonymous users create, write or delete
rules.fix: Remove create, write and delete from the anonymous role's table permission, or grant them to a role that requires sign-in.

rules.title: Site map opens a custom page that is not in the solution
rules.fix: Add the custom page to the solution, or add the solution that holds it as a dependency.

rules.title: Model-driven app has more than 25 custom pages, 10 connectors or 20 connection references
rules.fix: Move custom pages to another app, or remove pages and connections, until the app has at most 25 custom pages, 10 connectors and 20 connection references.

rules.title: Code app depends on a table or connector that is not in the solution
rules.fix: Add the table or connector to the solution, or add the solution that holds it as a dependency.
